items.prompt:
Quantitative evidence questions give you a:
A) table or graph
B) poem
C) map only

The correct answer must be supported by the:
A) data
B) longest option
C) first option

steps: Grounded in numbers. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Data: A=65%, B=40%, C=25%. Which city recycles the MOST?
A) City A
B) City B
C) City C

Data: A=65%, B=40%, C=25%. Which statement does the data support?
A) City A recycles a greater share than City B or C
B) City C recycles the most
C) All cities recycle equally
items.answer: A) City A recycles a greater share than City B or C

steps: Matches the numbers. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) City A recycles a greater share than City B or C

items.prompt:
Data: sales were 10, then 20, then 40 over three years. The trend is best described as:
A) rising (roughly doubling each year)
B) falling
C) flat

A statement that sounds reasonable but the data contradict is:
A) unsupported and wrong
B) the best answer
C) always correct

steps: Check the data. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Data: a study measured average screen time: ages 10-12 = 4 hrs, 13-15 = 6 hrs, 16-18 = 7 hrs.

Which statement does the data support?
A) Average screen time increases with age across these groups
B) 10-12 year-olds use screens the most
C) Screen time is the same at all ages
items.answer: A) Average screen time increases with age across these groups

solution.answer: A) Average screen time increases with age across these groups

items.prompt:
Data: a crop's yield was 5 tons with no fertilizer, 8 with low, 9 with medium, 9 with high.

Which statement is supported?
A) Adding fertilizer raised yield, but the gain leveled off at higher amounts
B) More fertilizer always raises yield sharply
C) Fertilizer lowered yield
items.answer: A) Adding fertilizer raised yield, but the gain leveled off at higher amounts

steps: 9 = 9 at the top. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Adding fertilizer raised yield, but the gain leveled off at higher amounts
